title: Your workspace at a glance
subtitle: Healthcare dashboard
narration: This is the Xacta platform, shown through actual screenshots from the demonstration environment. The dashboard brings operational activity and claim metrics into one view.

title: Follow the claims workflow
subtitle: Claim submissions
narration: The claims workspace brings statuses, claim types, and financial summaries together. The figures and approval statuses shown belong to saved demonstration records, not a new approval test.

title: Review the episode details
subtitle: Claim information
narration: Open a claim to review its type, dates, encounter details, and financial information. Clinical information, service items, responses, and review tools are organized into tabs.

title: Prepare the DRG inputs
subtitle: DRG and minimum data set
narration: The DRG workspace holds episode information, classification metadata, and conditional fields. An approved grouper connection is still required for automatic Saudi DRG assignment.

title: Choose the review you need
subtitle: Claims review assistant
narration: Inside the claim, choose guided claim review or experimental clinical documentation review. Save the information first so the assistant reviews the current saved record.

title: Make missing information visible
subtitle: Completeness findings
narration: The review displays missing fields and consistency questions with field references. These findings support preparation and review; they do not guarantee acceptance or clinical coding accuracy.

title: See the evidence behind a finding
subtitle: Local clinical documentation review
narration: Here is an actual local review result. The source note says, no systemic disease. The assistant flags the context for review rather than treating the extracted phrase as a confirmed diagnosis.

title: Evidence supports your team
subtitle: Human review remains essential
narration: Review the source, resolve questions, and keep the final decision with your team. Xacta combines structured claim checks with advisory assistance, without automatically changing the claim.
